intro: A new scene for each move. One resident, one supervisor, about a minute a scene. Speak the next line aloud before you open the comparison. The line shown is one possible line; agreement with it earns no credit.
ask: What would you say next? Give your own line aloud.

lines.text: A private conversation. No one has been invited yet.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: You can call my sister. Just don’t make it a big thing.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Thank you for telling me. What would you want her to understand? Is there anything you’d want me to keep out of it?

lines.speaker: June
lines.text: I don’t want help. I want my kitchen back.

lines.speaker: Paz
lines.text: Help is the whole reason I’m coming.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: You’re both saying help, and I’m not sure it means the same thing. June, what happens when Paz helps?

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Paz, what do you hope June feels when you help?

lines.text: Three times now, Odell has asked whether Tam is okay. Each time Tam has said “I’m fine” and looked at the door.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Odell, you ask if Tam’s okay. Tam, you say you’re fine, and Odell asks again. Is that how it goes, or am I missing something?

lines.speaker: Ari
lines.text: When I get home, I want to tell people myself. In my own time.

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.text: They’re already asking. I can’t just say nothing.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Devon, before you answer that, what did you hear Ari asking for?

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Ari, did Devon get it, or is there something you’d change?

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: It’s settled. I’ll drive her to every appointment and sit in.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Bea, I can hear how much you want to help. Ines, what part of that would you want, if any?

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Bea, is that something you can do?

lines.text: A few minutes are left. Cal and Rosa have agreed on one phone call a week. Rosa is on her feet.

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Rosa, before we stop, is there anything either of you still needs to say?

reply.speaker: Resident
reply.text: Who makes the first call, and when?
